posts.text:
How to own a keyword on YouTube with Grok Bot:

1. Set up a weekly routine where your Grok Bot finds a keyword in your space that’s rising month over month (Louise connects hers to vidIQ)

2. Have it check whether anyone has made a good video on it yet

3. If they haven’t, record the video this week

4. Let Grok Bot write the title, description and chapters around that keyword, then publish
posts.text_zh:
如何用 Grok Bot 在 YouTube 上占领一个关键词：

1. 设置一个每周例行任务，让你的 Grok Bot 找出你所在领域里环比持续上升的关键词（Louise 会把它接到 vidIQ 上）

2. 让它检查是否已有人就这个词做出过像样的视频

3. 如果还没有，就在本周把视频录了

4. 再让 Grok Bot 围绕这个关键词写标题、描述和章节，然后发布

posts.text:
I got to test Gemini 4 Neon early and it’s really good, really fast and about half the price of what I’m used to.

Then I saw the benchmarks, and it made sense. It scored about the same as Opus 5.5 on coding for around half the cost per task!

Claude is still often what I reach for on the hardest problems, and Opus still edges it on a couple of coding benchmarks.

But when you run agents literally all day, fast and half the cost is hard to ignore.

This is great news for anyone using agents, because competition like this pushes prices down for all of us.
posts.text_zh:
我提前体验了 Gemini 4 Neon，真的很好，速度很快，价格大概是我习惯的一半。

后来我看了评测，就理解了。它在编程上的得分和 Opus 5.5 差不多，但每项任务的成本大约只有一半！

遇到最难的问题，我通常还是会用 Claude，而且在几个编程基准测试上 Opus 仍然略胜一筹。

但如果你整天都在跑 agents，又快又只要一半成本，这就很难忽视了。

这对所有使用 agents 的人来说都是好消息，因为这样的竞争会把大家的价格都压下来。

quoted.text: JUST IN: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon, debuting at No. 1 on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index.
quoted.text_zh: 刚刚：Google 发布 Gemini 4 Neon，在 Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 上首发即登顶第一。

posts.text:
💯

In so many of my purchasing decisions these days I get frustrated that there is nothing that I want and I am getting scalped by crazy high prices for the most ordinary basic stuff

The basic end conclusion then is: I have to rip out the middle men

In case of furniture, the answer is design it myself and go to a carpenter to build it

There's going to be a big revival of artisanal jobs I think
posts.text_zh:
💯

近来我很多购买决定都会让我很沮丧：我想要的东西根本没有，而且最普通的基本款都被漫天要价宰得很惨。

于是最基本的结论就是：我必须把中间商剔除出去。

就家具而言，答案是自己设计，然后找木匠来做。

我觉得手工艺人的工作会迎来一次大复兴。

posts.text:
Scary NGINX vulnerability, but I checked and my VPS servers already had auto upgraded to the new one!

Very very very very very important to enable auto upgrades now, I even have auto reboot, which is a bit risky if you're not present, but I care more about my sites being up to date and safe than offline for a few hours

And generally security updates/upgrades are tested and safe
posts.text_zh:
NGINX 出了个吓人的漏洞，但我检查过了，我的 VPS 已经自动升级到新版本了！

现在开启自动升级真的非常非常非常非常非常重要。我甚至开了自动重启——如果你人不在场，这会有点冒险，但比起离线几个小时，我更在意站点保持最新、安全。

而且一般来说，安全更新/升级都是经过测试的，是安全的。

quoted.text: 🚨 Critical NGINX Vulnerabilities: @wiz_io Research, alongside @xint_official , @MetnirAI , @rapid7 , @ikotas00 independently discovered 2 critical memory-safety flaws in NGINX (CVE-2026-123633 & CVE-2026-123007) allowing unauthenticated RCE with HTTP/2 enabled. https://t.co/9uSNydq71Y
quoted.text_zh: 🚨 严重的 NGINX 漏洞：@wiz_io 研究团队与 @xint_official、@MetnirAI、@rapid7、@ikotas00 独立发现了 NGINX 中两个严重的内存安全漏洞（CVE-2026-123633 和 CVE-2026-123007），在启用 HTTP/2 时可导致未认证远程代码执行（RCE）。https://t.co/9uSNydq71Y

My friend @bai0 made something very cool

Local area networking (LAN) inside a webpage (or tweet!), meaning you can play any game or app that works over a local network on the web

You can try it in the tweet below, just click the box, you'll end up in a lobby chat and can then play GTA!

在网页（或推文！）里实现局域网（LAN），意味着你可以在网页上玩任何能通过本地网络工作的游戏或应用。

你可以在下面这条推文里试试，点一下那个框，就会进入大厅聊天，然后就能玩 GTA 了！
